segments.he: וכמו שרואין שיכולים לישב כל היום בחנות ולא ימכור כלום וכשבא הזמן ברבע שעה ירויח בעד כל העת וכן עפ"י רוב כשצריך לאיזה דבר וטורח בשביל זה אצל מי שחושב שאצלו ישיג את זאת ולבסוף לאזט זיך אוס גאר מט ולשוא עמל והשי"ת העלפט איהם פין מיין אנדער האהרט וואס ער האט זיך גארניט גרעכט אין עס איז אים גוור מט אהין גאפלין אז פין דארט קען קומין זיין ישועה כן יושיענו השי"ת במהרה אכי"ר.
segments.en: One of our fellowship was traveling to the Holy Land and on the ship laid out his tallis and the tefillin of Rashi and of Rabbainu Tam, as is the custom. There was on the ship one of the heretics, G-d preserve us, who laughed at him and mocked him, saying: "People like you — you are from the old world, not from today's world." He replied: "On the contrary — you are from the old world and I am from the new world." The heretic was astonished: what did he mean? He answered: "Understand — as it is written in the Haggadah: 'In the beginning our forefathers were idol-worshippers — and now the Omnipresent has brought us close to His service,' as stated in Yehoshua's declaration: 'Thus says Hashem — Beyond the river your forefathers dwelt of old, Terach the father of Avraham — and they served other gods. And I took your father Avraham from beyond the river and brought you.' Therefore I am from the new world — Hashem has brought me close to His service from now. But you are from the old world — from 'In the beginning our forefathers were idol-worshippers.'" This became a great source of laughter before all the passengers — and the heretic's face became like the bottom of a blackened pot.
